item.description:
• New **Uninstall** tab: remove Homebrew casks cleanly (with leftover cleanup) and, for manually-installed apps, scan for leftover files and move everything to the Trash — reversible, with a confirmation step before anything is removed
  • **Automatic updates** (opt-in): after a scheduled scan Kegwatch can install available app updates for you, skipping anything that needs a password and letting you know
  • The menu bar now shows when apps were **last scanned**
  • **Migration & backup** in Settings: export your apps to a Brewfile and reinstall them on another Mac
  • **Update history** with a monthly summary ("N updates this month") above the Updates list
  • Clearer help when Xcode's command-line tools license blocks a scan, with a one-tap copyable fix command
  • Refreshed **glassy** look with a new segmented tab bar
  • Cask rows now show the app's real icon
